requirements: R1: The system starts in the LoggedOut state.
R2: When valid username and password credentials are submitted while in LoggedOut, the system creates a session and moves to the LoggedIn state.
R3: When invalid credentials are submitted while in LoggedOut and fewer than five consecutive failed attempts have occurred, the system remains in LoggedOut and increments the failed-login counter.
R4: When a fifth consecutive invalid login attempt occurs while in LoggedOut, the system moves to the Locked state.
R5: While in Locked, login attempts must be rejected and the system must remain in Locked until the lockout timer expires.
R6: When the lockout timer expires while in Locked, the system clears the failed-login counter and returns to LoggedOut.
R7: When the user selects logout while in LoggedIn, the system terminates the session and returns to LoggedOut.
R8: When the user requests password reset while in LoggedOut, the system sends a reset token and moves to the AwaitingReset state.
R9: When a valid reset token and new password are submitted while in AwaitingReset, the system updates the password and returns to LoggedOut.
R10: When an invalid or expired reset token is submitted while in AwaitingReset, the system remains in AwaitingReset and rejects the reset.
R11: When the user cancels password reset while in AwaitingReset, the system returns to LoggedOut without changing the password.
R12: The system must not grant access to protected resources unless the user is in the LoggedIn state.
R13: While in LoggedIn, failed login rules must not apply and the failed-login counter must remain zero.
